verdict.rationale: RevenueCat ships 'Rico', a built-in conversational AI assistant in the dashboard that answers plain-language analytics questions (e.g., 'why did MRR drop'), and also offers AI-prompt paywall generation — both are in-product AI delegation features. However, these are narrow (analytics Q&A and paywall creation) rather than broad task delegation across the platform; deeper automation (managing products/entitlements) is delegated via the external AI Toolkit/MCP server for third-party coding agents, not the built-in assistant itself. missing for 10: evidence of Rico or another built-in assistant executing broader account/task actions (not just answering questions), and independent/hands-on validation of Rico's real-world reliability.
